findings.message: The slice end is `start + size + 1`, so every page returns one user more than `size`, and the last user of each page is repeated as the first user of the next page.
findings.suggestion: return [User(r["id"], r["email"], r["name"]) for r in rows[start : start + size]]

findings.message: The query now loads every user into memory on each page request and slices in Python, where the old `LIMIT ? OFFSET ?` let the database return only one page. Memory and latency now grow with the size of the table.
